question: How does the existing fixed five-minute direction score rank observed direction at each elapsed minute from 1 to 60?
signal: The original one-pass mixed-order logit_up at 5 minutes, fixed separately in each of four chronological development folds. The same fixed logit is compared with all 60 endpoints; this does not create 60 model outputs.
population: All original OOF parents in the four saved 2025 development folds; exact parent, bar, decision, 1/5/15 anchor, observed and sign joins required. Each horizon uses only observed, nonzero outcomes strictly before its own fold cutoff; ties, missing and immature are counted separately.
combined_auc: Sum concordant positive-negative pair counts within each fold divided by the sum of their pair counts; scores from different fold models are never ranked against one another.

uncertainty.resampling: Stratified within fold using all original OOF calendar blocks before horizon eligibility; identical resamples for all 60 horizons.
uncertainty.simultaneous: For each scheme, the 97.5th percentile of the maximum absolute bootstrap AUC deviation across all 60 horizons gives a common half-width; Bonferroni covers the two schemes. Report both intervals; bootstrap block exchangeability is an assumption, not proven.
uncertainty.undefined: Any replicate lacking positive/negative pairs is an explicit failure; no replacement draws.

limits: Repeatedly used development folds, not an independent new validation period.
One 5-minute model score measured against 60 targets; minute-specific models remain untrained.
No post-hoc horizon, threshold, checkpoint or model selection.
M1 candle midpoint does not prove executable quote age, entry, costs, profitability or full price path.
